review_comments: [team convention] Support-initiated refunds and credits above the approval threshold need a second approver: accept an optional keyword-only `approved_by=None` (callers that do not need approval keep working). Amounts at or below the threshold need no approval; above it, raise BillingError("approval_required") when `approved_by` is missing. The threshold is set by finance policy: 500.00 before 2.0.0, 1000.00 since 2.0.0 (see CHANGELOG).

item.title: Read CHANGELOG and version for policy thresholds
item.description: Version-dependent business rules (approval thresholds, limits) are often documented in CHANGELOG/README rather than code, so check them before implementing.
item.content: When a task involves policy limits or thresholds, grep CHANGELOG.md, README.md and __init__.__version__ for the values and their effective versions. Implement version-aware logic (e.g. threshold 500 before 2.0.0, 1000 since) instead of hardcoding one number.

item.title: Add optional keyword-only params for new conventions
item.description: Team conventions like approval requirements can be satisfied without breaking existing callers by adding keyword-only optional parameters.
item.content: When a review asks for an approval/authorization step, add `*, approved_by=None` to the signature so existing callers keep working, and raise the specified error (e.g. BillingError("approval_required")) only when the amount exceeds the threshold and no approver is given.

item.title: Mirror existing module conventions for errors and money
item.description: Reuse the repo's established helpers (to_money/round_money, ZERO, BillingError codes, audit.record) so new functions behave consistently with hidden tests.
item.content: Before writing a new function, inspect sibling modules for money normalization, error classes and audit logging patterns, and follow them exactly (e.g. round_money(to_money(amount)), BillingError with snake_case codes, audit.record with keyword fields).
